title: Validation rejections return 422, not the 400 the spec implies
evidence: schemas.py:8 title/author are Field(..., min_length=1); FastAPI's request-validation error handler returns HTTP 422 (README.md:31 documents 422). R9's how_to_verify expects rejection with 400.
suggestion: Optionally add an exception handler mapping RequestValidationError to 400, or accept 422 as the framework-idiomatic rejection code.

title: Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event("startup")
evidence: main.py:18 @app.on_event("startup") — deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers in current FastAPI.
suggestion: Migrate to the lifespan context-manager API.

title: Pydantic v1 idioms (orm_mode, .dict()) with unpinned deps
evidence: schemas.py:14,28 Config.orm_mode = True and main.py:39,67 book.dict(); requirements.txt:1-5 pins no versions, so a fresh install pulls Pydantic v2 where these are deprecated.
suggestion: Pin pydantic<2 or migrate to model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and model_dump().

title: DELETE returns a JSON body with a 204 No Content status
evidence: main.py:81 returns JSONResponse(status_code=204, content={}); HTTP 204 must carry no body. Passes under TestClient but can trip strict ASGI servers.
suggestion: Return Response(status_code=204) with no body (FastAPI already sets 204 via the route decorator).

title: Validation-rejection path (R9) is not covered by a test
evidence: tests/test_api.py has 5 tests (health, create+get, update, delete+404, author filter) but none asserts that POST /books without title/author is rejected.
suggestion: Add a test posting an empty/missing-title payload and asserting a 4xx status.
